FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A37
A crosswalk identifies the area where pedestrians may cross, and drivers must yield to people entering or already in it. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A37
Crosswalks are not always marked, so look for pedestrians at intersections even without painted crossing lines. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A37
When a sign or signal requires stopping, stop behind the applicable stop line, crosswalk or traffic-control device. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A37
When stopping is required and no crosswalk is apparent, stop before entering the intersection. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A37
A stop line located before a crosswalk is the first stopping boundary to obey. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A37
A shared center lane is reserved for left turns, or U-turns where permitted, from either travel direction. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A37
Shared-center-lane pavement arrows alternate left-turn directions for the opposing traffic streams. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A37
Each side of a shared center lane has a solid yellow line and a dashed yellow line. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A37
Enter a shared center turn lane only after ensuring it is safe. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0037]
